notes: Workflow bypass in OAuth authorization code flow. Token issued without validating redirect_uri and state parameter. Fixed by adding validation steps before token issuance.
Workflow bypass in Django admin actions. Model saved without CSRF validation and data cleaning for bulk actions. Fixed by adding CSRF check and data cleaning.
Workflow bypass in JWT verification. Access granted without validating algorithm (alg:none attack), verifying signature, or checking expiry. Fixed by adding required validation steps.
Workflow bypass in macOS Gatekeeper. Binary executed without code signature validation and quarantine check. Fixed by adding required validation gates before execution.
Workflow bypass in GitLab CI. Pipeline runs without CI config validation and runner authorization. Fixed by adding validation and authorization gates.
